criterion_notes.L5: No public URL. Pressing Publish opens "Get a plan to publish your project" — publishing needs a paid plan. The trial build expires in six days, so there is no address to test and nothing that stays online.

failures: L5: publishing is behind a paywall; the free trial site expires.

artifacts.label: Builder: site generated, publish blocked by the plan dialog

notes: Hostinger's signup needed no email confirmation and no captcha, which made it the smoothest start of any tool in this batch. The agent then built the page in one prompt: the preview shows the studio name, treatments, a contact section and the Valletta address. Everything stops at publish: the button opens a plan dialog, and the trial site is deleted if it is not paid for. So the page exists but never becomes reachable.

pricing.free_plan: AI Builder trial only; the site expires after the trial and cannot be published without a plan
